$comment: Contract for the SetRoleAssignmentActive server-side command (AD-003, AD-041, AD-037/OD-010). Deployed via the registration console (plugins/OutcomeTesting.Registration) and added to the OutcomeTesting solution via a solution-file import (src/customapis/al_SetRoleAssignmentActive). Custom API parameter Type codes: 0=Boolean, 10=String.

customApi.name: al_SetRoleAssignmentActive
customApi.description: Withdraws or restores a person's application role by flipping the state of the al_userrolemapping row. Deactivation preserves the row and its history (OD-010). Enforces permission.manage Manage and writes an immutable Audit Event (BR-012).

requestParameters.name: MappingId
requestParameters.description: Id of the al_userrolemapping record to withdraw or restore.

requestParameters.name: Active
requestParameters.description: True to restore the assignment, false to withdraw it.

requestParameters.name: IdempotencyKey
requestParameters.description: Stable key for the intent; a replay returns the same result.

responseProperties.name: AuditEventId
responseProperties.description: Id of the Audit Event written for this command.
